gaps: X_ITE 16.6.0 projects per slice, not along the whole ray, and the bridge copies it: the numbers (AVERAGE of a uniform volume is 38, MIN with no hit is white) are X_ITE, not the projection the specification describes

the march direction is the view direction in volume axes, not divided by the dimensions (as in X_ITE), so a volume with unequal dimensions projects along a different line than its shape suggests; only cubes are tested
a projection value near a layer boundary (the sample at 0.37537 against the edge at 0.375) depends on the exact slice plane; the fixture keeps the layers thick and probes one centre pixel per volume
a ProjectionVolumeStyle inside a Composed, Blended or the style list of an isosurface or segmented volume is dropped (it is not composable)
